snippet.title: Theropods - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1091870/Theropods/

Theropods is a visually striking point-and-click adventure set in a lush, prehistoric world full of dinosaurs.

Created pixel by pixel, frame by frame, Theropods is more than a retro throwback. It plays like a lost gem of the ’90s, but with the clarity and confidence of today.

Developer: Lost Token
Publisher: Dionous Games
